events.description: Casing was reciprocated to regain circulation after suspected bridge in the annulus, which caused the Silixa cable to part in tension.
Displacement fluid could only be pumped for 27 bbls due to high pressure (~6,200 psi) reaching the limit of casing capacity.

lessons_learned: If optic cable is installed, do not reciprocate casing.
Never reciprocate casing if fiber cable is installed on the OD of the casing.
If Silixa cable is installed, request an updated temperature profile during cementing procedures and adjust cement slurry accordingly.
